limits: Static exterior and visible memorial hall using1899 architectural drawing,2007 mosaic,2008 east facade and2018 statue/portal details. Berlin official heights55m and36m observation floor,4m raised terrace. Original architectural master preserved; reviewed local master adds marble figure, four interior iron portraits, gold/blue eight-rib vault, opposite colored eagle shields, lower-turret foil recesses, paired back glazing, sparse photo-supported antenna equipment and two side flights; erroneous rear main staircase removed. Sculpture posture and broad relief/mosaic forms are medium-fi reconstructions, not measured likenesses or exact ornaments; inscriptions keep documented text through original line glyphs. Stair rises/runs, interior plinth/figure proportions, minor fittings and date-sensitive equipment remain photographic estimates. Hidden internal stair/rooms, detached restaurant, furniture/vegetation and current operations excluded. Terrain contact assumes locally level approach at lower stairs; host must fit terrain without embedding the4m platform. Exact mapped terrace controls position/orientation, not all exterior stair edges; footprint replacement is disabled.
